image_description: A side-profile view of a large, dark brown bison standing on a dirt path. The bison has a massive shoulder hump covered in shaggy fur, a large head with short curved horns, and a beard. Its hindquarters are less furry than the forequarters. In the background, there is a grassy field with other bison grazing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, broad, and features two short, curved horns consistent with bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct fringe of long hair hangs from the chin and throat area.
The eye is visible and appears dark, though partially shadowed by fur.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick head fur.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and high withers typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark fur, creating a very prominent hump.
The rear section of the body has significantly shorter, smoother hair compared to the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are proportionally small relative to the massive size of the head and body.
Legs appear sturdy. Hooves are visible on the feet touching the ground, appearing consistent with cloven structure.
The tail is visible hanging down, ending in a distinct bushy tuft of hair.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and their connection to the massive torso.
To check for melting or blending artifacts between the shaggy fur and the background/ground.
To assess texture consistency in the fur and detect any subtle generative noise or blur.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency (shaggy vs smooth transition)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy forequarter fur and the smoother hindquarter fur. AI often struggles with this textural gradient. Also, verify that the hooves are firmly planted on the ground without 'melting' into the dirt texture.
